title: Trend Rider
briefing: Lumen Bikes is in a strong uptrend and Orchard Foods is creeping higher. Join the trend on a pullback and let it run.
objective: Trend following: buy pullbacks in an uptrend, protect them with a stop and trail the exit.
debrief: Lumen Bikes kept making higher highs and higher lows. The dips after the battery-supplier report (day 8) and the analyst downgrade (day 19) were the low-risk places to join, and both held above the rising average. The trend finally cracked when the company cut its forecast on day 29. A disciplined player bought a pullback with a stop, held through the noise and trailed out when the trend broke.
